parameters.name: BgColor
parameters.description: The background color of the subtitle. Specify the value in RGBA format.

parameters.name: BgWidthNormalized
parameters.description: The background size of the subtitle. Valid values: [0, 1].

parameters.name: CopyFrom
parameters.description: The subtitle template to copy from. Set this parameter to the value of SubtitleName.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The custom description of the subtitle. The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and special characters, and can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: DstLanguage
parameters.description:
The target language for translation. Valid values:
- English: en-US
- Chinese: zh-CN
- Spanish: es-ES
- Russian: ru-RU.

parameters.name: FontColor
parameters.description: The font color. Specify the value in RGBA format.

parameters.name: FontName
parameters.description:
The font. Valid values:
- KaiTi: KaiTi (default)
- AlibabaPuHuiTi-Regular: Alibaba PuHuiTi Regular
- AlibabaPuHuiTi-Bold: Alibaba PuHuiTi Bold
- AlibabaPuHuiTi-Light: Alibaba PuHuiTi Light
- NotoSansHans-Regular: Noto Sans SC Regular
- NotoSansHans-Bold: Noto Sans SC Bold
- NotoSansHans-Light: Noto Sans SC Light.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description:
The height of the preview screen. Unit: px.

The width × height of the preview screen supports only the following specifications:          
- Landscape low definition 360P: 640 × 360 
- Portrait low definition 360P: 360 × 640
- Landscape standard definition 480P: 854 × 480
- Portrait standard definition 480P: 480 × 854
- Landscape high definition 720P: 1280 × 720
- Portrait high definition 720P: 720 × 1280
- Landscape ultra-high definition 1080P: 1920 × 1080
- Portrait ultra-high definition 1080P: 1080 × 1920.

parameters.name: MaxLines
parameters.description: The number of lines to display.

parameters.name: PositionNormalized
parameters.description:
The position of the subtitle. The value is the x,y coordinates with the bottom-left corner of the screen as the origin.

> The x and y values must be normalized. The actual values are multiplied by the video height. For example, if the video height is 720p and PositionNormalized is set to [0.1, 0.5], the actual position of the subtitle is x = 72 and y = 360.

parameters.name: ShowSourceLan
parameters.description: Specifies whether to display the source language. Default value: false.

parameters.name: SrcLanguage
parameters.description:
The source language. Valid values:
- English: en-US
- Chinese: zh-CN
- Russian: ru-RU.

parameters.name: SubtitleName
parameters.description: The name of the subtitle template. The name can contain only digits, letters, and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with a hyphen.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the preview screen. Unit: px.

parameters.name: WordPerLine
parameters.description: The number of characters per line. Valid values: integers in the range of [1, 500].
